title: Detection of Fast Incoming Objects with a Moving Camera
summary: 用户转头/晃动产生全局 optical flow，被误当作物体接近

mechanisms.name: Detection of Fast Incoming Objects with a Moving Camera — dtr:DR16 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: 全局相机运动补偿后的 residual flow、looming 和质量门
mechanisms.limitations: 无人机/快速物体视频；纹理不足、模糊、遮挡和身体几何仍未解决
